title: Undocumented
description: What `docs(query)` MUST return for a query the corpus cannot answer (RFC §5.2.3). It does two jobs: it records the miss locally (and MUST NOT transmit it anywhere), and it explicitly suspends the completeness contract for this one question, permitting the agent to consult source. The fence has a gate, not a gap.

comprehendo.description: The spec version this provider implements, e.g. "0.1".

code.description: The sentinel code. Fixed by the RFC, not provider-owned.

nearest.description: Did-you-mean candidates. REQUIRED, and MAY be empty.

source_permitted.description: REQUIRED, always true. The permission is the point of the shape: an UNDOCUMENTED that could say false would be a gap pretending to be a gate.
